application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years. Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall be carried out as closely as possible in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'. Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals. Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2017) as amended.

The proposed crown reduction is too heavy for the size of the tree (T1) and conflicts with the recommendations in BS3998:2010 "there should still be a strong framework of healthy small diameter and twigs (leaf bearing structure) capable of producing dense leaf cover during the following growing season". Should a further application be submitted for a more sympathetic crown reduction, or for pruning of any individual branches which may be conflicting with the building, the council may accept the proposed works.

The proposed works (T4, T5, T6) conflicts with the recommendations in BS3998:2010, by removing too much leaf bearing structure, and inflicting too large wounds upon the trees "there should still be a strong framework of healthy small diameter and twigs (leaf bearing structure) capable of producing dense leaf cover during the following growing season", "the cuts should not exceed 100mm in diameter".Too much energy storing structure will be removed from the trees, resulting in less available energy for defence and re-growth.Should a further application be submitted for more sympathetic crown reduction after the trees have responded further to the previous crown reduction, or for pruning of any individual branches which may be conflicting with the building, the council may accept the proposed works.
